mapper.insert: insert into kb_graph_index ( kb_id, graph_version, previous_graph_version, status, step, entity_count, relation_count, community_count, level_count, extractor_version, community_version, report_version, gds_available, gds_version, dirty_at, started_at, finished_at, error_type, error_msg ) values ( #{kbId}, #{graphVersion}, #{previousGraphVersion}, #{status}, #{step}, #{entityCount}, #{relationCount}, #{communityCount}, #{levelCount}, #{extractorVersion}, #{communityVersion}, #{reportVersion}, #{gdsAvailable}, #{gdsVersion}, #{dirtyAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{errorType}, #{errorMsg} ) on conflict (kb_id) do update set graph_version = excluded.graph_version, previous_graph_version = excluded.previous_graph_version, status = excluded.status, step = excluded.step, entity_count = excluded.entity_count, relation_count = excluded.relation_count, community_count = excluded.community_count, level_count = excluded.level_count, extractor_version = excluded.extractor_version, community_version = excluded.community_version, report_version = excluded.report_version, gds_available = excluded.gds_available, gds_version = excluded.gds_version, dirty_at = excluded.dirty_at, started_at = excluded.started_at, finished_at = excluded.finished_at, error_type = excluded.error_type, error_msg = excluded.error_msg
mapper.update: insert into kb_graph_index (kb_id, graph_version, status, dirty_at) values (#{kbId}, #{graphVersion}, 'DIRTY', now()) on conflict (kb_id) do update set dirty_at = now(), status = case when kb_graph_index.status = 'RUNNING' then kb_graph_index.status else 'DIRTY' end, graph_version = coalesce(#{graphVersion}, kb_graph_index.graph_version)
mapper.insert:
insert into kb_graph_community ( kb_id, graph_version, level, community_id, parent_community_id, rank, entity_count, relation_count, source_chunk_count, content_hash ) values
(#{item.kbId}, #{item.graphVersion}, #{item.level}, #{item.communityId}, #{item.parentCommunityId}, #{item.rank}, #{item.entityCount}, #{item.relationCount}, #{item.sourceChunkCount}, #{item.contentHash})

insert into kb_graph_entity_community ( kb_id, graph_version, level, community_id, entity_key, entity_name ) values
(#{item.kbId}, #{item.graphVersion}, #{item.level}, #{item.communityId}, #{item.entityKey}, #{item.entityName})
mapper.select: select count(*) from kb_graph_entity_community where kb_id = #{kbId} and graph_version = #{graphVersion} and level = #{level}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_graph_community_report ( report_id, kb_id, graph_version, level, community_id, title, summary, full_content, findings_json, source_count, token_count, model_code, prompt_version, content_hash, status, create_time ) values ( #{reportId}, #{kbId}, #{graphVersion}, #{level}, #{communityId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{fullContent}, #{findingsJson}, #{sourceCount}, #{tokenCount}, #{modelCode}, #{promptVersion}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{createTime} ) on conflict (report_id) do update set title = excluded.title, summary = excluded.summary, full_content = excluded.full_content, findings_json = excluded.findings_json, source_count = excluded.source_count, token_count = excluded.token_count, model_code = excluded.model_code, prompt_version = excluded.prompt_version, content_hash = excluded.content_hash, status = excluded.status, create_time = excluded.create_time

insert into kb_graph_community_report_source (report_id, chunk_id, evidence_rank) values
(#{item.reportId}, #{item.chunkId}, #{item.evidenceRank})
on conflict (report_id, chunk_id) do update set evidence_rank = excluded.evidence_rank
mapper.delete: delete from kb_graph_community_report_source where report_id in (select report_id from kb_graph_community_report where kb_id = #{kbId})
